notes.title: Tetraphobia Q2 Developer Update 2025
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

It’s been quite a while since I’ve done one of these development updates, rest assured Tetraphobia has been chugging along in development albeit a little slower than previously due to some ongoing IRL changes! 

I wanted to show off some of the recent changes I’ve been making for the newest titan who will be joining “The Four” in the Fractured Sky. The Titan of Greed represents all things trade and currency and his realm is full of valuables and riches that his followers have hoarded. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158496/7fd521ad8d6a8ccd7c8de99f7202add134c9aec2.png[/img]

Exploring his realm will give you unique artefacts that help with your currency generation along with battling through a host of enemies that launch gems and other exciting valuables at your head.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42158496/264fdb26df15b59e7b6118ed56f356678d1d2877.png[/img]

I expect to publish this new patch in the coming month which will be the final region for Tetraphobia. You can expect a few more of these updates as I head closer to pushing Tetraphobia out of early access.

Cheers,
Danny - Tetraphobia Solo Dev

notes.title: 🏹⛩️ Tetraphobia MAJOR Rebalance Patch 0.7.1 🏹⛩️
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Tetraphobia is already 3 months in it's early access journey which has flown by! Thanks for everyone who has bought and wish listed the game and special thanks to those who are providing feedback on discord.

This patch is focussed on smoothing out the early game experience and making the combat feel significantly more balanced. Tetraphobia suffered from some game design flaws and an unfair approach to RNG that were making the game more frustrating than fun. 

If you want a detailed breakdown of some of these changes you can check out my latest dev-log!

[previewyoutube=amqd6g37ut0;full][/previewyoutube]

Now onto patch notes!

[b]Tetraphobia Patch Notes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Improved the visuals on the player and enemy to make them clearer to see
[*] Completely redesigned the trinket system to make it easier to get earlier powerups
[*] Completely redesigned the enemy spawning system to make island spawns feel more balanced
[*] Sumo-Rai boss redesigned 
[*] Go-Pogo boss replaced with 3 smaller enemies
[*] Headache boss nerfed
[*] Artefacts rebalanced
[*] Can no longer escape from the dojo on the tutorial boss
[*] Other small bug fixes
[/list]



I hope you guys find the new patch a lot more fun and if you're still having issues please do reach out on discord or use the feedback form in the game!

Best of luck on your journey through the fractured sky,

Cheers,
Danny (Tetraphobia Solo-Dev)

notes.title: Patch V0.6.7
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Another bug fixing patch to help smooth out some of the smaller and annoying issues affecting gameplay.


[list]
[*] Fixed a problem that caused the player to get stuck in a permanently falling loop
[*] Removed the bushes from the shroom spore boss island to stop players getting on top of them and avoiding attacks.
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing the character to be able to move during the respawn animation and ramen screens
[*] Fixed an issue that caused food to not be dropped when using the vitality thorns food.
[*] Fixed an issue that made the trinket menu unusable when using the controller and upgrading the centre item.
[*] Fixed an issue causing the Four-Splosion achievement from not popping.
[*] Fixed an issue with some islands causing loot to be too high to collect
[*] Other small issues
[/list]

I will now be focussing on game balance and smoothing out the onboard experience for new users. Specifically, I want to ensure that players get hooked earlier in the gaming process instead of getting frustrated and stuck. If you’re currently experiencing this then keep an eye out for the next update!

Thanks for all the support,
Danny (Tetraphobia Solo-Dev)

notes.title: Patch V0.6.4
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

I'm busy fixing a number of small and minor bugs but there was a few major issues that I wanted to fix quickly.

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue causing xbox elite controller to not work
[*] Fixed an issue where portals to islands would sometimes not lock when you had the exploding cats powerups
[*] Fixed an issue where the Health Modifier in the Tetradays would work when selected.
[/list]

Thanks for all the support so far and if you have any bugs, balance problems or want to give feedback please message me on the discord server!

Cheers,
Danny (Tetraphobia Solo-Dev)

notes.title: NEW TRAILERS AND DEVELOPMENT UPDATE 🏹⛩️
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Your friendly Tetraphobia developer has emerged from his coding cave!

Sadly, I have been pretty terrible at keeping development updates here and I apologise for that. Making a game by yourself is really hard and things like dev updates always seemed to end up at the bottom of the list. I will improve this when the game is in early access I can start to deliver more iterative updates.

Now, onwards to the future - Last week Tetraphobia released it's new Story Trailer which helps explain the Titans origins and detail the world you're about to make chaotic. I'm extremely pleased with how it came out and I think it really helps to give some context of why you're slinging your arrows around (and what's all this about cat treats?). Check them out on the store page!

As for development - Tetraphobia is entering it's final bug fixing and polish phase. I've been through numerous iterations with a small testing group from friends and Discord members - I'm extremely close to having my final build ready for steam and am anticipating having the build ready in about two weeks. I'm unsure of when exactly the release date will be due to other Steam marketing promos happening around this time but I'm hoping for Late November or Early December.

I hope those of you that have wishlisted or followed are still enticed by Tetraphobia and will snap it up during Early Access.

Here's to more of these development updates and an exciting early access release. 
Cheers,
Danny (Tetraphobia Solo Dev)
